interfaces._publish_prepared_target_object(path, pa: CPU-only exact-format atomic writer using common.publish and artifacts._finish; returns reference/emitted_payload_sha256/emitted_payload_bytes. Hash bytes as emitted from validated value; verify final reference against that hash/count. No new encoding.
interfaces._prepared_namespace_identity(work_dir, t: Check exact normalized lexical roots, expected resolved paths and ordered literal aliases; capture scoped ordinary-directory device/inode/type without mutable ancestor mtime. Roots/leaves ordinary. Entry-local only.
interfaces._read_prepared_target_object(target_refe: Returns (frozen_value, entry_references, namespace_identity, phase_witness, observed_io). Exact marker/child/type/hash/nonfinite contract, same-buffer target hash/parse, one freeze and separate entry witness; no execution authority. Return observed_resources alongside observed_io: actual decoded/frozen graph retention and applicable overlapping temporary-buffer observations, using the same identified recipe as the anchored resource record.
interfaces.prepare_pilot_target(args, design, proto: Existing prepare action pilot-target; read completed original pilot inventory via args.inventory, validate it unchanged, build exact full target, independently validate on CPU, publish target+descriptor after fresh guards. Returns preparation object reference; no model argument.
interfaces._validate_prepared_receiver_resources(re: Root-anchored exact artifact/reader/freeze/environment/recipe validation; return separate retained/extra-transient resource charges and reject insufficient actual capacity before reading/loading. No unmeasured sharing subtraction or tier reduction. This is the early check only; it cannot replace the post-reader observation comparison.
interfaces.load_prepared_pilot_target(args, design,: Production derives all expected refs and resource record from freshly validated root pilot admission/context, not caller booleans. Reads the data, seals one PID-local graph and binds exact source/part/workdir/pilot/admission/reservation references. CPU measurement uses only the lower data reader and never mints model authority. After decode/freeze, compare actual observed retention and applicable transient/peak bounds against that SAME correctly identified anchored record, then refresh original actual-capacity/live/deadline/model guard before loader; reject understatement even with enough nominal host capacity.
interfaces._PreparedPilotTarget.assert_scope(args,: Reject wrong PID/seal/context/part/namespace/ref or graph replacement; data handle cannot grant execution or be serialized/reinitialized.
interfaces._PreparedPilotTarget.final_publication_b: After union+before_publication: exact entry-bound namespace/full witness; original fresh live guard/effective deadline; cheap unchanged identity/alias seal; final deadline. No adopt-current path.
interfaces.run_pilot(..., prepared_target=None): Production requires loader-minted handle and performs no target rebuild/publication/readback. Explicit injected reference path remains for differential fixtures only; fresh native aggregate must use prepared path.

root_admission_extension.rule: Whole admission body/hash remains anchored by existing original mapping. Descriptor/resource references alone never authorize a model. No new admission kind.

canonical inventory SHA and complete unchanged summary/bounds

resource_rule: Keep original pilot/authority/model/numeric obligations and full original tiers. Add separate retained and extra-transient metadata charges; do not subtract presumed overlap. A fixture existing50+retained20+extra30 needs capacity100 and rejects99. Actual allocation contract must back root capacity. A CPU producer peak is not a receiver bound.

planned_receiver.rule: Prove actual counts; if higher, report and revise cost/feasibility before acceptance, not hide calls or weaken witnesses.

receiver_observation_contract.scope: Same target buffer, parse, freeze and exact retained requirement graph; include receiver handle and retained entry references. Observe before releasing temporary buffers and before invoking model loader. Measurements are data, never authority.
receiver_observation_contract.method: Identify the receiver accounting recipe in resource record and code hash. Count actual byte/text buffers and retained decoded/frozen object graphs by object identity with cycle-safe unique-object accounting; count simultaneous raw/decode/freeze/memo lifetimes rather than assuming aliases or overlap savings. Record actual process/cgroup current/peak observations as applicable to that recipe and actual host-capacity guard. Same accounting/environment/scope must be used by bound evidence and production receiver.
receiver_observation_contract.comparison: Early authenticated bounds plus host obligations must fit actual capacity before large read. After reader, EACH actual retained/transient or applicable peak observation must fit the corresponding anchored bound; matching identity/ample nominal allocation does not waive this comparison. Refresh actual capacity and original model guard afterwards. If an observation cannot be obtained or scope cannot be reconciled with the resource recipe, reject; sampled RSS/cgroup values alone do not prove an upper bound.
receiver_observation_contract.no_subtraction: No producer-peak inference, unmeasured alias or baseline subtraction, reduced M2 tiers, or resource record self-authorization.

read_count_clarification: T1 lower reader includes same-buffer hash/parse plus entry phase-witness mint: two target reads/SHA passes. Its explicit final phase-witness recheck is the third. T3 integrates that recheck in final barrier; never add another startup scan merely to obtain three. Startup receiver and final proof time are charged once each, including in workload.project_cost.
